extDescription.message: Declines cookie banners for you, and hides the ones it can't decline. Never clicks Accept.

detailRejected.message: Clicked “Reject” on this page’s cookie banner.

detailSaved.message: Switched optional cookies off and saved.

detailHiddenDecline.message: This banner had no way to say no, so it’s out of sight.

detailHiddenHide.message: Hid this page’s cookie banner without answering it.

detailQuiet.message: No cookie banner on this page so far.

detailHideMode.message: Banners on this page are hidden by the cookie list and stay unanswered.

detailOff.message: Cookie Munch leaves this site alone.

detailNeedsAccess.message: In Safari Settings → Extensions → Cookie Munch, allow it on every website.

detailNotWeb.message: Cookie Munch works on web pages.

helpDecline.message: Clicks “Reject” on cookie banners. Hides the ones that can’t be declined.

helpHide.message: Like Brave: hides banners and stops their scripts loading. Never answers them.

report.message: Missed a banner here? Report it

reportHint.message: Opens a GitHub issue with this site’s name and your setup (mode, version, Mac or iPhone) filled in. Nothing is sent unless you submit it.
